neighbours.label: a repeated clause frame in a chain (A leads to B, B leads to C; if they X him, they will Y him), firing where the repeated frame is copied
fire: Practice builds skill, skill builds confidence, confidence builds success, and success builds habit.
If you feed them, they will trust you; if they trust you, they will stay.
Hard work brings results, results bring praise, and praise brings more hard work.
Fear leads to anger, anger leads to hatred, and hatred leads to suffering.
When they call us, we answer them; when they need us, we help them.
Rain feeds the river, the river feeds the lake, and the lake feeds the town.
If we listen to them, they will talk to us; if they talk to us, we will learn.
Saving creates wealth, wealth creates freedom, and freedom creates choice.
quiet: Practice matters to most musicians, along with talent, patience and a good teacher.
If you feed the cat early, it usually sleeps quietly until the afternoon.
Hard work is valued by many employers, though few of them say so openly.
Fear is a normal response to danger and often fades once the threat has passed.
When the phone rang, we were already outside and nobody heard it.
Rain fell all night, and by morning the river had flooded the lower fields.
If we leave now, we might still catch the last train into the city.
Saving is hard for young people, especially when rents keep rising each year.
